visual.name: plumeGauge
visual.description: Gauge with the Plume Studio look: semicircle, 240° and 270° arcs, ring, free angles, horizontal and vertical linear gauges and bullet chart; value, minimum, maximum and target from fields or fixed; 2 or 3 color ranges (% of scale, values or measures); needle; one gauge per category; premium: thermometer, 4 and 5 ranges, ranges in % of target, gap arc to target, comparison with previous period, play axis with animated needle, history sparkline, multiple needles and car-dashboard dials.
